# Click-limited links (and an idempotency fix)

## Using it

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/urls -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"url": "https://example.com/offer", "max_clicks": 1}'
```

After `max_clicks` redirects the link returns `410 Gone` with `link has reached its click limit`.
Omit `max_clicks` for an unlimited link (the default; existing links are unlimited).

The limit is approximate under concurrent load: clicks are counted just after the redirect, so
simultaneous requests can exceed it by the number in flight.

## Upgrade notes

Startup adds the nullable `urls.max_clicks` column to existing databases automatically
(`add_missing_columns`). The migration only adds nullable columns and refuses anything else.

## Bug fix

Replaying an `Idempotency-Key` after its link was deleted used to return `200` with a dead
short URL. It now returns `410 Gone` so the client knows to create a new link.

## Decision (ADR-003)

Additive startup migration instead of adopting a migration framework now; destructive or
NOT NULL changes still require a reviewed migration.

decisions.rationale: Operators need to know the schema changes at startup
